Wide parking lot is visible; many vehicles occupy marked bays and background skyline structures are visible.
View remains wide; parked vehicle rows and their relative positions are visible. Some changes between sampled frames are consistent with vehicle movement, but no complete trajectories are asserted.
Wide view continues. A number of vehicle-like forms occupy the same general rows; small changes in positions/orientation occur in sampled frames.
A light-coloured elongated vehicle-like form is visible in a middle-left lane/row, with its orientation and position changing across nearby samples.
The light-coloured elongated vehicle-like form is farther across the middle-left portion of the view than in some earlier samples; exact path remains unresolved.
Wide lot view persists; vehicle placements differ from the opening view, while many parked vehicles remain in rows.
Final sampled frame shows the wide parking-lot view continuing; no confirmed cut is visible within this final sampled instant.

sampling_note: One frame per second is a sparse temporal sample. Intermediate motion, exact vehicle paths and identities are not fully recoverable from these samples alone.
identity_policy: Movement is not duplication. Where continuity between similar vehicles is not established, retain uncertainty rather than force correspondence.
